name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: Largest quake this week M6.4; no high-impact alerts
state: USGS recorded 135 earthquakes of M4.5+ in the 7 days to 1 Nov, four of them M6+; the largest was an M6.4 south-east of Easter Island (29 Oct), and an M6.0 struck off Shima, Japan on 31 Oct. All PAGER alerts were green, with no M7+ and no tsunami flags.
for_you: No current high-impact earthquake. Earthquakes cannot be forecast; follow local guidance in seismic zones.
rubric_hit: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.

sources.title: USGS — M6.4, southeast of Easter Island

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
